svg.title: Tax Enforcement
svg.desc: Oath & Action Civic Line R-27 Tax Enforcement, the 24 px pixel fit in use: drawn pixel by pixel on the 24 px grid with a one-pixel line, every pixel Charcoal or empty, keeping the parts that make its master read. One color, the black edition only (D2-1132). Use it at 24 px on 1x screens; from 2x the master draws instead, the pillar icons' switch (DR-179). Approved by name on drawings board C (DR-209) and put into use on November 11, 2026.
